content: NativeWind latest stable is 4.2.6 (v5 only as 5.0.0-preview.4, not stable). Peer dep tailwindcss >3.3.0 but v4 engine requires tailwindcss 3.4.x (latest 3.4.19); Tailwind v4 not supported on NativeWind 4. Installs via withNativeWind metro wrapper; no babel plugin needed on SDK 57 (babel-preset-expo handles reanimated 4.5 + react-native-worklets 0.10.1); nativewind-env.d.ts + types entry in tsconfig. Confirmed working on Expo SDK 54 template; SDK 57 uses same setup with css-interop 0.2.6.
